command:
$ErrorActionPreference = "Stop"
$repo="tngkrwlsmd/flyExplorer"
$branch="work/large-folder-name-index"
$expected="6936fba97d2e18ac81115b5d02b84db7e90472dd"
$ref=("heads/" + $branch)
$encoded=[uri]::EscapeDataString($ref)
$obj=gh api ("repos/" + $repo + "/git/ref/" + $encoded) | ConvertFrom-Json
if($obj.object.sha -ne $expected){ throw ("ref moved: expected " + $expected + ", got " + $obj.object.sha) }
gh api --method DELETE ("repos/" + $repo + "/git/refs/" + $encoded)
if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){ throw "branch delete failed" }
Write-Host ("DELETED_BRANCH=" + $branch)
Write-Host "LARGE_FOLDER_NAME_INDEX_BRANCH_CLEANUP_PASS"
